summary: WorkReadPort::get: one task's summary plus its v1 detail projection (task fields, latest attempt, published result basics), ported from WorkStore.get with the deep projection set (retry/delivery/workflow/cicd projections) left to the typed-projection increment.
signature: pub(crate) fn get(store: &crate::work_store::PgWorkStore, project_alias: &str, task_id: uuid::Uuid) -> Result<forge_work::TaskView, forge_work::WorkError>;
responsibilities: Run in one session transaction (session.in_tx). First the task SELECT pinned in the pattern; no row -> WorkError::not_found("task").
Build the projection object: prompt, acceptance_criteria, latest_attempt_id, plan_decision_id, review_required, workflow_required, workflow_id, workflow_review_id from the task row (nulls stay null).

When latest_attempt_id is non-null AND status != queued, run the attempt SELECT pinned in the pattern; when a row exists add projection.attempt = {attempt_id (string), worker_id, phase, started_at (format_ts), finished_at (format_ts or null), summary, published_at (format_ts or null), result_sha256, result_byte_count, result_chunk_count} and, when published_at is non-null, projection.result = {result_sha256, result_byte_count, result_chunk_count}.
invariants: The v1 projection is a documented subset of Python's get() DTO: no retry, delivery, workflow-progress, review, or cicd projections (they return with the typed-projection increment that retires TaskView's Value debt).
